download_orig_fits_for_capture_id: download and decompress original fit files for a given ReInterHand capture ID from the S3 bucket
run_download_all_captures: run the script to download and extract all original fit files for every capture ID in the list
create_capture_directories: create the directory structure for each capture ID before downloading original fit files
download_single_capture_split: download a specific capture ID split using wget and decompress with tar
review_download_function: review the download function that handles wget downloads and tar extraction for ReInterHand data
